name: Aparat (www.aparat.com) — Persian video-sharing platform
description: Aparat (آپارات) is Iran's largest Persian-language video-sharing service (the 'Iranian YouTube'). NOT an AI chat site — the ui2api surface here is video discovery: search, trending, and video-detail reads driven through the site's own JS-rendered SPA. Scaffold package: the user's 'araprat' was resolved to Aparat via web search (the literal domains araprat.com/.ai/.io do not resolve); no bundle analysis and no live browser round-trip have been performed yet.

capabilities.name: Video search
